create_apply_if_finite: create a gradient transformation that skips updates containing NaN or Inf values
create_multi_steps: create a gradient transformation that accumulates gradients over multiple mini-steps before applying the inner optimizer
create_masked: create a masked gradient transformation that applies an inner transform only to parameters matching a boolean mask
create_conditionally_transform: create a gradient transformation that conditionally applies an inner transform based on a step-dependent boolean function
create_skip_not_finite: create a gradient transformation wrapper that skips parameter updates when gradients are not finite
